name: 38047-mtpsharegpt-2b-1gpu
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine on one GPU.
architecture: ~2B hybrid-attention decoder (Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration). The MTP draft head ships inside the checkpoint, so no second model is loaded; the repo also carries a vision tower, unused here.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1000, bounded at 1000 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, no warmup and no cooldown -- one request per stream, every prompt served once.
workload: guidellm `json_file` over `configs/data/sharegpt-1000-qwen35.jsonl`: 1000 single-turn ShareGPT prompts with a per-row output length, temperature 0, chat-templated on the way in, so wire length runs above declared length by the template's wrapper. 224742 prompt tokens over 1000 rows; mean 225 prompt tokens, p50 85, p90 654, max 1017; mean 208 output tokens, p50 149, p90 498, max 908.
purpose: A 2B chat assistant with built-in draft decoding handling 1000 concurrent one-shot conversational prompts on a single GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B

speculative-config: {"method": "mtp", "num_speculative_tokens": 1}

# Must stay on ONE line: the reader is flat and would drop the block form, starting the
# engine without the key.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"video": 0}

tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
